cases.title: Валюта и граница периода
cases.description: Валютный платёж отражён по прежнему курсу и попал в следующий месяц.

policy.invoice_recognition: Recognize each original base-currency invoice once at issued_at
policy.allocation: Allocate booked base-currency cash up to the original invoice outstanding balance; previous receipts reduce that balance before allocation faults
policy.allocation_order: Chronological source payment timestamps, unique per invoice
policy.currency_scope: Invoices are base-denominated; receipts may use any declared currency
policy.fx_date: Source payment timestamp converted to the fixed business offset of period_start
policy.refunds: Negative base-currency payments refund previously unapplied surplus only
policy.missing_refs: Null invoice_refs means unapplied cash, not an inferred invoice link
policy.cutoff: Compare membership in [period_start, period_end) of the source document and journal timestamp
